decisions: Lead/lag compares topic frequency series with bounded integer shifts using Pearson correlation over overlapping periods.
A positive lag means the follower series is shifted later and therefore follows the leader; negative lags represent the inverse relation.
Selection prioritizes absolute correlation, then the smallest absolute lag, then positive lag deterministically; strength is absolute correlation.
Insufficient or constant series return no result rather than inventing a relationship; the framework is local and dependency-free.
risks: Correlation does not establish causality and can be inflated by shared trends; causal validation is outside this framework.
The current API compares topic series, while source-specific cross-source grouping requires a future source identity contract.
